手摸过小铲子，又要拿点心了。水、肥皂和双手一起，能把许多污物带走。它们各做了什么: You have been holding a little garden spade. Now it is snack time. Water, soap and your hands can work together to carry away much of the dirt. What does each one do?
肥皂、清水、干净毛巾，准备好了吗？: Soap, clean water and a clean towel. Ready?
看着干净，也值得洗一洗: Looking clean is not the whole story
有些污物看得见，许多微生物却太小，眼睛看不见。吃东西前、上厕所后，把手洗好，能减: We can see some dirt, but many microbes are too small to see. Washing well before eating and after using the toilet helps stop harmful microbes from hitching a ride on our hands.
微生物并不都是坏家伙。我们的皮肤上也住着许多无害、甚至有帮助的微生物。洗手不是把: Microbes are not all harmful. Many harmless, even helpful, microbes live on our skin. Washing does not turn our hands into a lifeless, germ-free planet.

屏幕上的点选只帮助记住步骤，不会测量手是否洗净。真正洗手时，要用肥皂搓洗至少 2: Tapping the screen only helps you remember the steps. It cannot measure how clean your hands are. When washing for real, scrub with soap for at least 20 seconds, cover both hands, then rinse and dry.
松动，还要带走: Loosen it, then carry it away
油污不容易只靠水洗掉。肥皂里的小分子能和水、油污打交道；加上来回搓洗，许多污物和: Water alone does not easily remove grease. Soap molecules interact with both water and oily dirt. Rubbing with soap loosens much of the dirt and many microbes. Running water then carries them away along with the soap.
大泡泡里面主要是空气。泡泡多不等于洗得更干净，别为了堆泡泡一直挤肥皂。把所有部位: A big bubble is mostly air inside. More bubbles do not mean cleaner hands, so do not keep adding soap just to make a foam mountain. Covering every area, then rinsing and drying, matters more than counting bubbles.
用干净的流动水，冷水或温水都可以，不需要烫水“杀菌”。请大人帮忙调到舒服的温度。: Use clean running water, cool or warm. You do not need scalding water to kill germs. Ask a grown-up to help set a comfortable temperature. Turn off the tap while rubbing and turn it back on to rinse.
这些时候，记得洗手: Remember to wash at these times
先想一想：刚刚摸过什么，接下来要做什么？: Think: what did I just touch, and what will I do next?
吃饭、拿点心、准备食物前: Before meals, snacks or preparing food
别让手把污物带到食物上。: Keep dirt on hands from reaching food.
即使看不到脏，也要用肥皂和清水洗。: Use soap and clean water even if you cannot see any dirt.
擤鼻涕、咳嗽或打喷嚏后: After blowing your nose, coughing or sneezing
尤其是手碰到了鼻涕、唾液或用过的纸巾。: Especially if your hands touched mucus, saliva or a used tissue.
摸过动物、动物食物或垃圾后: After touching animals, animal food or rubbish
玩得开心，洗好手再继续。: Enjoy exploring, then wash before moving on.
本页讲家庭与日常生活中的洗手。普通肥皂或用于水洗的洗手液配合清水即可；不需要把“: This page covers handwashing at home and in everyday life. Ordinary bar soap or liquid hand soap with clean water is suitable; an antibacterial label is not a requirement. Surfactants help detach soil from skin, while rubbing, rinsing and drying work together. Handwashing does not promise to remove all microbes or every chemical contaminant.
这里把洗手分成五站，方便记忆。CDC 建议用皂搓洗至少 20 秒；这不包括打湿、: The five stations are a memory aid. CDC recommends scrubbing with soap for at least 20 seconds; that is not the total time for wetting, applying soap, rinsing and drying. WHO's healthcare handwashing diagram gives 40–60 seconds for the whole procedure, with a different setting and timing scope. Help children cover backs, finger spaces, thumbs, fingertips and nail edges. Rub gently; do not scrub skin red.
洗完用干净毛巾或干手设备把手弄干；湿手更容易传播微生物。本篇不演示含酒精的免洗消: Dry with a clean towel or an air dryer; wet hands transfer microbes more readily. This page does not demonstrate alcohol-based hand sanitizer. Soap and water are especially appropriate when hands are visibly dirty or greasy.
放大图是教学绘图：皮肤、油污、微生物和肥皂分子没有按真实比例绘制；颜色、颗粒数和: The close-up is a teaching drawing. Skin, grease, microbes and soap molecules are not to scale. Colors, particle counts and movement do not represent species, quantities, germ-killing rates or measured cleaning. Bubbles are decorative; the small heads and lines in the close-up are simplified molecular symbols. Selecting five areas means you have viewed five explanations, not that real handwashing has been verified. The cover is an AI-generated everyday-life illustration.

两只手掌相对，来回搓一搓。掌心的褶皱也要照顾到。: Rub your palms together, back and forth. Remember the creases, too.
用一只手的手掌搓另一只手的手背，再交换。图中圆圈提示的是同一位置的背面。: Rub the back of one hand with the other palm, then swap. The circle points to the back of the same spot on this drawing.
让两只手的手指交错，来回搓洗每道指缝。别忘了手指侧面。: Interlace your fingers and rub back and forth between them. Remember the sides of the fingers.
用另一只手握住拇指，轻轻转着搓，再换另一边。: Hold one thumb with the other hand and gently rub around it, then swap.
把指尖并拢，在另一只手的掌心轻轻打圈，照顾指尖与指甲周围，再交换。: Bring your fingertips together and rub gently in circles against the other palm, covering fingertips and nail edges. Then swap.
水先打湿皮肤。图中的棕色团块代表油污，深色小形状代表部分微生物；它们小得多，这里: Water wets the skin first. The brown patch stands for grease, and the small dark shapes stand for some microbes. They are much smaller in real life; this is only a close-up diagram.
第一站：用干净的流动水打湿双手。: Station 1: wet both hands with clean running water.
肥皂来帮忙：分子的一端容易和水相处，另一端容易进入油污。浅色圆头和短线是分子符号: Soap helps: one end of a molecule interacts readily with water, while the other can enter oily dirt. The pale heads and short lines are molecular symbols, not bubbles.
第二站：关上水龙头，涂上肥皂或水洗型洗手液。: Station 2: turn off the tap and apply bar soap or liquid hand soap.
来回搓洗产生摩擦，配合肥皂让污物松动。图里的上移只表示“松动”，没有表示真实速度: Rubbing creates friction that works with soap to loosen dirt. The upward movement means 'loosened'; it does not show a real speed or a cleaning percentage.
流动的清水把松动的污物和肥皂带走。少量微生物符号仍留在皮肤上：洗手并不等于让皮肤: Clean running water carries loosened dirt and soap away. A few microbe symbols remain on the skin: washing does not make skin sterile.
第四站：用干净的流动清水，把肥皂冲洗干净。: Station 4: rinse the soap off thoroughly under clean running water.
最后，用干净毛巾或干手设备把手弄干。画面没有给出“洗净分数”，真正的清洁取决于实: Finally, dry your hands with a clean towel or an air dryer. The picture gives no 'cleanliness score': real cleaning depends on what you actually do.
屏幕练习完成。现在记住：用皂搓洗至少 20 秒，冲净，再擦干。: On-screen practice complete. Remember: scrub with soap for at least 20 seconds, rinse, then dry.
两只手都要洗；掌心、手背和手指各处都要照顾到。: Wash both hands, covering palms, backs and every part of the fingers.
